blends.desc:
A Scrubbed Scrap is a Chunk of Dirty Scrap that has been polished up and scrubbed until Cleanliness is achieved. This tedious task is done in order to identify the object beneath all the dirt and grime.  Once cleaned, the scrap is much more useful, especially if it turns out to be a really rare and sought out part. If one is lucky enough, their hard work will be well worth the effort…


*This asset will be openable as a pack soon...*

blends.name: Lucky Miner's Medallion
blends.desc: The owner of the Lucky Miner's Medallion is often weary of showing it off to others. Its luckiness is so powerful that things just seemingly fall into their lap.  Their luck in finding vast deposits of gold and other riches in the soil is simply uncanny.  Some like to attribute this to skill, but the medallion knows better.  This special charm actually twinkles so brightly that it can amplify any light source and reveal glimmering pockets of gemstones.  Construction of a Lucky Miner's Medallion begins with a simple chain made of pure silver that is looped through an opening in a Magic Twig, which is fortified with a glue made from Giggle Goo and Mead. This brilliant work of craftsmanship is embedded with a Blue Kyanite, a Perfect Ruby, an octagonal step cut Emerald, a beautifully polished Gold Nugget, and a large brilliantly cut amethyst at the bottom end.  Adorned through the end of this masterpiece is a crescent forged from Black Silver and Mixed Metal. This gives the medallion the appearance of a miniature pickaxe fit for only the best miners around.

blends.name: Dung Key
blends.desc:
This item will be needed to claim "Slain Dung Titan' drop.


*What looked like a normal dropping ended up being a Hardened Dung Key. This special key is eaten by beasts so that no one can access their secret layer. You wouldn't want to enter there unless you are thoroughly prepared...*

blends.name: Dung Silk - MUST HOLD 'Villager' AND 'Dung Silk Spider Nest' TO BLEND THIS WEEKLY
blends.desc:
MUST OWN '[Dung Silk Spider Nest](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/funmangalaxy/blends/blend.nefty/30088)' AND '[Villager](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/funmangalaxy/blends/blend.nefty/27699)' TO PRODUCE Dung Silk WEEKLY.

Dung Silk is only produced by Dung Spiders, as it could never be produced using human or goblin technology. All attempts at making such a fine dung silk have resulted in stinky catastrophes that should not be spoken of... Dung Silk is soft, pure, and it doesn't even stink, but is made from pure dung after being processed by a Dung Spider. The precious material is often fought over to the point of Dung Spiders being driven into scarcity, as they are often abused when they are taking from their natural habitats. Dung Silk is used for fine clothing, interior design, goblin aerial silks and more!

blends.name: Dung Silk Spider Nest
blends.desc:
A Dung Silk Spider Nest is a group of Dung Spiders who have come to work together in creating prized Dung Silk. This silk is always in high demand by the Dung Monks, as it is used to make their robes. Dung Silk is a unique material only known to be produced by Dung Spiders. It is incredibly soft and silky, but is also a very strong material, which doesn't rip easily. The quality of the silk they produce depends on the quality Dung the spiders are consuming, so a Dung Crystal should be used to provide crucial minerals to the Dung Spider and provide the nutrients needed for a quality Dung Silk. As much love and attention as possible should be given to this spiders, so it is important that a Worker cleans out the nest weekly and brings fresh Smelly Essence for the Dung Spiders to feast on, and then the silk will surely flow.


*Can be occupied by a Worker, and requires Smelly Essence.*


Travel to Koocunoop Village on Telegram to Learn More: [Trading Plaza of Koocunoop Village](https://t.me/funmangalaxy)

blends.name: Sterilized Dung Brush
blends.desc:
This Sterilized Dung Brush is hand crafted with only the highest quality materials that sometimes will stink like death. It has likely been used to scrub a Goblin Toilet Bowl for so long that it was encased in Dung. However, after being sterilized, this brush will clean just as well as any other. It is sterilized using an ancient method, which involves heat and ashes applied to different type of stinky materials. Not only does this process sterilize this useful tool, but it helps to solidify it together with a protective Dung shell, which makes this brush into a strong and useful cleaning tool.


*This Brush can be used to claim "Cleanliness" NFT drop.*

blends.name: Scorpion Hide Body Armor
blends.desc: Scorpion Hide Body Armor is a breastplate made from Scorpion Hide and stingers, obtained from a Giant Scorpion which can often be found roaming the desert sands of the Funlands. Often crafted by Nomads (who have been supplied the hides by desert bandits, who kill the Giant Scorpions for fun), these strong pieces of armor insulate and protect the wearers body from the harsh temperatures of the desert, keeping them cool while also providing physical protection from predators and opponents in battle. It is also equipped with Giant Scorpion Stingers and ready to inject venom into anyone who comes too close to the one who wears this stunning breastplate. There is a powerful scroll woven into the hide, which binds the hide together in an ancient pattern that always holds to the test of sturdiness. Not only is the scorpion hide look fashionable, but it is also lightweight and the go to top of a Scorpion Samurai.

blends.name: Ruby Gold Chain
blends.desc:
This Ruby Gold Chain necklace could be enchanted to make an Ember Amulet. Otherwise it is super fashionable, and wearing it is a symbol of prosperity among kings and fools.


[Funman Metaverse](https://toadshaman.wixsite.com/funmangalaxy)

Join on Telegram: [Trading Plaza of Koocunoop Village](https://t.me/funmangalaxy)

blends.name: Ember Amulet
blends.desc:
Embers fling off of this beautiful necklace as if it were plucked directly from the depths of magma. While it looks like it would be hot to the touch, it actually feels nice and cool across your chest while filling your insides with warmth and determination! An Ember Amulet is a Pyro Shaman's friend, for it is said that the wearer of this amulet can create a fire that burns half the fuel for twice the flame. It is crafted from pure gold and a Perfect Ruby, and enchanted with Promethean Favor and a Vial of Mystic Liquid. These elements are what gives the necklace its immense source of profound combustion power, but there is one key that must be unlocked in a shaman's heart to craft such an amulet, the key to the heart of the flame!

[Funman Metaverse](https://toadshaman.wixsite.com/funmangalaxy)

blends.name: Travelist's Pack
blends.desc:
*Must hold a funmantribal asset with the skill: Ancient Goblin Wisdom in order to blend.*

The funman world is full of unexplored wonders and you never know what you may find out there. That's why we've put together this fine Travelist's Pack, brought to you by Gobco! Each pack is hand crafted by goblin artisans and built from the highest quality leathers for durability and style. It comes with a hatchet for chopping wood and/or self defense, flint and tinder for starting fires, a compass to navigate through the Funlands, a small length of rope, dried rations for at least three days of food, bandages in case of injury, a notebook and ink to document your journey, and a leather satchel with lots of storage to carry all of the treasures you find along the way. It is used especially by Skilled Explorers and Tomb Raiders, but even the Gnome Tramp loves a good basic traveling kit. It contains all an adventurer needs for their journey. Don't delay, get yours today! *only from the fine makers at Gobco. Preparation is the cure for obliteration!

blends.name: Distilled Urine
blends.desc:
Originally concocted as a battlefield projectile to be launched from catapults onto unlucky foes, Distilled Urine has a wide range of usage. It was discovered that, through the process of fermentation and distillation, even just the fumes can actually get a pretty mean buzz going for most anyone. As such, the weapon was never properly tested in battle… Laughing Witches later realized the vast uses of this golden liquid, also known as lant. It works wonders for cleaning, tanning leather, yellow dye production, diluted into plant fertilizer, and even can be used in rare cases for gunpowder production! Once Fresh Piss becomes this concentrated, it only takes a few drops around one’s garden to ward off varmints from eating the precious crops.

This asset can be staked to earn hourly wax - WAX Farm: https://waxdao.io/farm/funmanbobwax

blends.name: Stellar Specs
blends.desc:
These Stellar Specs are the best glasses for scientific experimentation. Offering a thick, protective lens that can focus on incredibly tiny things, these fashionable spectacles are sold for a steep price to crazed scientists who prefer their glasses to be just so.

*Stellar Specs are an extremely rare pack drop needed for various funmagalaxy blends.*

blends.name: Hunter's Bow - Collab Blend with supremekings collection
blends.desc:
The Hunter's Bow is crafted with an incredible amount of patience and a touch of ingenuity, using mostly commonly found materials. Wielding this bow allows one to hunt wild animals for Game Meat. With practice, the poor man becomes a hunter, and may provide more than just a Wild Salad for their village.

This asset allows one to earn Game Meat NFT with Chanting Spell bot on telegram.

blends.name: Pine Forest
blends.desc: The Pine Forest is a great place to be for those who enjoy nature. The scent of fresh evergreen is in the air! A Gatherer would know how to collect all of these pine needles with ease. The dried pine needles crunch under each step taken, and little pine cones litter the forest floor. Its nicely shaded, the birds sing, and a small fire is often burned to keep bugs away. Pine Needles can be used to hold in moisture, helping plants grow, but also can be used as an ingredient to build certain structures. With enough pine cones saved up, you could start your own Pine Forest!

blends.name: Lucky Bag of Charms
blends.desc: This Lucky Bag of Charms is said to protect the holder from evil spirits and unfortunate events. It is filled with rare crystals and trinkets from various places and different time periods. The leather bag is soft, and the charms softly hit one another as the bag moves, amplifying their magic with every step.

blends.name: Mud Furnace
blends.desc: A Mud Furnace can be built in just a few days with the right knowledge. Sticks or bamboo rods are stuck into the ground and tied together with vines. Mud is then prepared and mixed with fine sand and hay to create a strong and fibrous, brick hard structure. It is built with multiple combustion chambers for the creation of large quantities of charcoal. It is filled with wood, set aflame, and sealed off with a heavy clay slab once the hot coals accumulate to create a Mound of Charcoal. This is the first step to expanding a village. Charcoal can be used to purify water, used as fuel, and is great for the skin!

blends.name: Cob Brick Oven
blends.desc: A Cob Brick Oven can be built in just a few days with the right knowledge. A hole is dug and an area made ready for the oven. Mud is then prepared and mixed with fine sand and hay to create a strong and fibrous cob that is packed into bricks and set out to dry till they are hard as a rock. These bricks are then glued together with mortar to make a sturdy oven that can be filled with Charcoal and set aflame to cook food to perfection.

blends.name: Giggle Farm
blends.desc:
This Giggle Farm is the best way to grow Giggle Goo fast! Giggles are in the air, on the ground and everywhere at this special farm. Giggle Goo from the Giggle Flowers is an important staple needed by every Giggle Town. With a Laughing Witch's help, you could get this farm set up and running in just one day's time. It will be hard to wipe the grin off of one's face once the Giggle Flowers are in bloom.

*This asset may produce Giggle Goo!*

blends.name: Kittana
blends.desc: Kittana is for protection and attraction. This rare token is created with the spirit of a lioness warrior. Those who wield this token are unstoppable in battle and become a natural magnet for success and confidence.

blends.name: Frogbert
blends.desc: Aside from being a sign of prosperity, the Frogbert token brings purification and renewal as the song of the frog brings the rain. It also allows one to transform, becoming a walker between worlds. Few know of its capabilities because it can only be used by those patient enough to catch a fly.

blends.name: Baby of Infinite Possibilities
blends.desc:
Give the Laughing Witch the right supplies and she will find a child for you! A great trade for both sides! :)

"This Baby of Infinite Possibilities was found alone and in need of a home. It is energetic and covered in slobber and will grow to be a healthy adult in the right environment. Surround this baby will love to make them happy and strong!"

blends.name: Goblin Granny’s Magic Chompers (Shiny)
blends.desc: This mean set of magic pearls is the best bite-ware around, cutting chewing time in half. The magic teeth with never rot or chip, and they are brilliantly fashionable. A Goblin Granny will never go far without these beautiful chompers. Forged with mystic enamel and bound together with Magic Tree Sap and baked Grotesque Goo, these special teeth are near impossible to come by because of how scarce these enchanted materials can be. Once a Goblin Granny wields a tooth of this caliber, one must be careful to stay for away from her magic bite, which can have different effects on different people, especially effecting those who have upset the Goblin Granny.

blends.name: Dentures
blends.desc: Dentures are an artificial pair of chompers for elderly Goblin who have lost all their teeth over the years from the many fights they partook in and other unfortunate incidents, too gruesome to describe here, which sometimes involves gut wrenching amounts of candy...  These dentures are usually assembled from teeth gathered up from the floors of bars and taverns, and sometimes even teeth found while digging in the dirt of the wastelands. No matter where they come from, real teeth are always used to make Dentures such as this. They are held together with Tree Sap and baked Giggle Goo for strong durability even while eating.  Those who are hopelessly addicted to the pungent tincture of Dung Mead are all too familiar for the need for dentures due to the rotting quality of the devil’s brew… Although getting hands on some Dentures this nice is proven difficult, there may be some benefits to having no teeth at times…

blends.name: Paper Bomb
blends.desc:
*Must own a Pyro to make this blend.*

A Paper Bomb is a fun way to add a little pop to the celebration and light up the night sky! They get their name from the little paper envelope that contains the blast powder inside, which can be folded and loaded in different ways to create different explosion patterns and can even be colored using rare color pigments. Made from common scraps and a few household materials, paper bombs are easy enough to come by if you have the blast powder to load them! Fanatics of fire such as the Pyro Shaman horde Paper Bombs such as these in order to create massive monuments to fire, which are burned during times of celebration or rebirth, in an epic display across the night sky. The shamans say that lighting one of these massive effigies at just the right time will scare away evil spirits, banishing them into the night with a loud crack and a sky full of rainbow stars.

*Used for massive Pyro belnds.*

blends.name: Pyromaniac's Crest
blends.desc:
*Must own a Pyro to make this blend.*

Pyromaniac's Crest is a symbolic tradition, passed down by pyros. Rigged with colorful explosives and packed full of extremely flammable materials such as Mound of Charcoal, Gunpowder, and Orb of Flame, this glorious testament to combustion is a reminder that nothing lasts forever, and that starting over with a patch of freshly scorched earth is the perfect stage for new beginnings. Sometimes the crest becomes a competition amongst the Pyro Community, lasting for days or even weeks at a time. The winner is often times the one whose fire burns the longest, while at other times, the focus is intensity, with the flames towering into the heavens to touch the stars. There is no real way to know who wins, but the event will conclude with music and mead, and the Pyro Community, although smelling of ash, will sleep well knowing that a burn has occurred.

Requirements: 6 Paper Bomb, Orb of Flame, Bucket of Hot Lava, 4 Gunpowder, Settlement, 2 Thunder Crash Bomb, 33 Mound of Charcoal, 11 Crucial Primordial Elements

*Must hold a 'Pyro' type 'funmantribal' asset, such as the 'Pyro Shaman' to blend. *

blends.name: Interdimensional Djinn
blends.desc:
The Interdimensional Djinn is a being from another realm, who has the ability to open a portal between worlds, bringing items back and fourth with them from one dimension to another. Unlike the Interdimensional Genie, who is playful and kind, offering you objects that are from another plane of existence, the Djinn is aloof, thinking himself too cool to bother with such things. He will gladly take a tug of your spliff though, if you are willing to share. The Interdimensional Djinn is an extremely practiced wielder of sorcery, and takes magic to a new level, unknown by the mortals on this planet, but the cool cat wouldn't even show you unless it was life or death. On rare occasions, Djinns may choose to enter a mortal's dreams, inadvertently fulfilling the deepest desires of their subconscious mind. The Interdimensional Djinn always has a secret trick or two up their sleeves...

*This asset is a weekly airdrop target for random NFTs.*

blends.name: Healthy Medungion
blends.desc: The Healthy Medungion is a special necklace that radiates with a warm and natural energy. Holy Dung from a Dung Monk is kept in the pristine locket.  The significance of this amulet is made clear by the chain that holds this special dung relic. The chain is crafted from a rare Black Silver, and coated in some sort of all natural grease, which is what gives this fine piece of jewelry its alluring smell and powerful attraction and expulsion properties...

blends.name: Dung Spell
blends.desc:
The Dung Spell is one of the most ancient traditions, and one of the very first traditions that most animals partake in. It can be performed anywhere, but the spell is best cast from an Ivory Pot. This special form of manifestation spell involves casting out waste, to make room for new life. Reusing everything is integral to the Dung Spell, as one Funman's waste is another's treasure.


*This asset will increase odds for rare drops when chatting in telegram, as well as allow for DUNG token drops.*

blends.name: Leaf House
blends.desc:
Sometimes a lucky leaf in the wind will lead one to a Leaf House. Crafted from the finest leaves around, this house is home to those who are in tune with nature. Leaf homes are found mostly on hillsides overlooking the grand swamp across from the village. Many leaf houses can be seen in and around the hillside with happy toads and Leaf Sprites dancing, especially in the light of the full moon’s wake. In order to find the Leaf House, one must have a true beleif that it exists, otherwise ancient treefolk magic will conceal it under cover of wild bramble. When properly taken care of, a Leaf House is a warm and welcoming abide for voyagers from across the Funlands. Sometimes a special Leaf will be given to travelers who visit a Leaf House, but this gift is only given to those who help keep plants alive and not given to those who are at war with nature.

*Must own [Rebuild Mallet](https://wax.atomichub.io/market/?template_id=530565) to blend this stakable airdrop target.*

blends.name: Spiced Honey Mud Mask
blends.desc:
MUST HOLD '[Villager](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/wax-mainnet/funmangalaxy/700833)' TO BLEND 'Spiced Honey Mask'

The Spiced Honey Mud Mask is the perfect way to rejuvenate one's face after a long day in the Forgotten Wastelands. The cool temperature of the mud will provide physical relief to any sunburn, while the healing properties of the Spiced Honey heals one's damaged skin.  This mask is also called the Savage Mask because some tribes wear it as camo in times of ambush. Once washed off the face, the skin underneath this mask will be left silky smooth, as the clay draws out dirt and impurities from the skin.

blends.name: Bucket of Healthy Soil
blends.desc: A Bucket of Healthy Soil is a bucket of the finest growing medium around for fresh produce. The Laughing Witch would be honored to smell such a fine batch of live earth. It is used to to make plants happy throughout the Funlands.

blends.name: Villager
blends.desc: A Villager is a foundational worker of a Town Center who spends most of their life occupying a Settlement and the surrounding farmlands. Unlike voyagers who travel searching for free loot, a Villager works hard to produce whatever is needed by the village.  They go about their lives engaging in tedious jobs and simple pleasures such as farming, sewing, fishing, construction, and crafting.   Every Villager has one important common purpose: to help ensure that a healthy village lives on. To achieve this they frequently take pleasure in procreation, and take good care of their offspring.   In all of these activities, a Villager takes much pride and joy... but there are few who long for more.   Every now and then, one of these unsatisfied workers will go on to lead a life of great adventure and wonder, but many of them will die trying, sometimes being eaten alive by dragons or other majestic beasts.   To some village elders, this is seen as an honorable end, as it actually helps to protect the village from monster attacks. A brave and ambitious Villager tends to divert threats and quells the hunger of powerful beings, that would rather prey on easy targets than attack an entire village. Regardless, a Villager is incredibly useful for various tasks and is always willing to put in the hard work needed to make a Town Center thrive.

blends.name: Useful Ceramic Bowl
blends.desc:
This Useful Ceramic Bowl is skillfully crafted from a large Block of Clay. It is usually fired with the heat from a village forge, so that extra materials are not required. A lot of clay is used to ensure that the vessel is created with perfection, making this bowl durable and lightweight. Its versatility makes it a favorite among the common Villager, as it is used to prepare and serve food in, used to gather ingredients such as fresh water or wild berries, and is used to store away small items and help keep a village home organized.

- Requires 55 Block of Clay
- Needed for the Villager blend
- Stakable on Waxdao

blends.name: Primitive Talisman
blends.desc:
The Primitive Talisman is crafted over a long period of time, using energy that is drawn from the wisdom of elders past. The ancient device can be used by a Villager as a sort of compass, to douse raw resources and detect when certain elements are nearby. This useful device is said to channel energy and unlock ancestral memories. This means that long forgotten memories can be seen as a vision by the one who holds this extraordinary relic. It is said that these talismans were created before the Great War, as an attempt to protect tribal knowledge, which was suppressed for many centuries before the fall of civilization...

- Requires 55 Crucial Primordial Elements.
- Needed for the Villager blend
- Stakable on Waxdao

blends.name: Baby of Infinite Possibilities - Letter from Mom Blend
blends.desc: This Baby of Infinite Possibilities was found alone and in need of a home. It is energetic and covered in slobber and will grow to be a healthy adult in the right environment. Surround this baby will love to make them happy and strong!

blends.name: Reaper's Harvest Chest
blends.desc:
The Reaper's Harvest Chest is only rewarded to those who have enough Champion's Coins to purchase it. Champion's Coins are rewarded in duels to the winner of a duel. This chest will include one Harvest Sickle or a rare scythe as well as a chance at a rare farm called Field of Wild Grains!

Stinky: Harvest Sickle, Fresh Produce, Wild Grain,
 Decent: Bloodmoon Scythe, Dust Cluster, 
Rare: Corwesian Flamingo Scythe, Field of Wild Grains, 
Mystic: Soul Siphon, Skull of the Fallen Crystal Giant, 
Legendary: Whipmaw Scythe, Golden Drumstick, 
Titan: Slice of Heaven, 
Fun: Professor Glorpelog's Spinning Blade Machine

blends.name: Dust Bunny
blends.desc: The Dust Bunny is a magical creature that was manifested into existence by the beliefs and imagination of goblin children everywhere. A truly remarkable beast, which can appear out of mere dust...  Before being manifested into a living creature through magical means, their non-living version is made when a large amount of dust, hair, lint, and spiderwebs, which is often accumulated over time and combined in a confined space such as under a bed or some other piece of furniture. Parents would warn their young goblins not to touch them as they may house mites and other parasites similar to ones that live on real live bunnies, thus earning them their namesake.  Once being manifested into a living creature, however, their magical essence will constantly keep them clean and organized, and they often become a helpful house companion as they will roam one's dwelling, collecting Dust Clusters to replicate themselves as quickly as a normal bunny would reproduce, and in the process will keep all of the nooks and crannies of the dwelling nice and tidy, without any need for a goblin house maid.

blends.name: Dung Monk
blends.desc: The Dung Monk is a dedicated servant to the ways of dung. Night and day he contemplates excrement, expelling toxins and making room for more grub. This is the way of dung, and it is respected by all citizens of a Dung City. The Dung Monk spends most of his time in the Dung Temple, in which the monk has formed his abode, taking an Oath of Stinkitude, where the monk must live in the ways of Dung for a full year. Every waking moment, eating, bathing, or even sleeping is anticipation of the sacred time, when one is alone with their thoughts to expel and release all that they do not need. The Dung Monk has made it his duty to live in such a way, that all toxins are totally expelled, and each choice leads to a healthier, more wholesome dung.

blends.name: Giant Keg of Mead
blends.desc:
This Giant Keg of Mead is the perfect way to get a party started! There are Dwarven drinking competitions in the Drunken Madhouse every year where brave Drunken Dwarfs successfully down an entire keg to themselves! The Giant Kegs of Mead are often rolled into the Mining Caves full, then after hours of hard work and excessive drinking, the barrel is filled with Iron Ore or rare gemstones and rolled back to the tavern where it is refilled in exchange for a small fraction of the gemstones within.

*Requires 3 Rainbow Ale, or 165 Mead*

blends.name: Wasted Wanderer
blends.desc:
Stinking of booze and always ready to start a fight, the Wasted Wanderer has clearly had a few too many meads. Once a wanderer has reached this level of intoxication, they are quite a challenge to control, be them friend or foe. The Wasted Wanderer has the ability to travel much further than a standard Wanderer, by using his Goblin Motorbike, but he often struggles to find his way back home, runs out of Biodiesel, or simply just crashes the bike in an epic explosion. This lifestyle is harsh on the liver, but can be rewarding on the rare occasion that the drunken stupor leads to a greater good. He duel wields his Meads till he is so drunk that only a bloodied glass or some stinky concoction remains... The Wasted Wanderer is a violent drunk, a comedic specialist, and a highly experienced biker.

*This is a weekly airdrop target for the Spoils of a Drunken Stupor.*

blends.name: Mysterious Sparkle Wand (Shiny)
blends.desc: The green velvet staff is heavy, as if filled with rocks, and wrapped in silk banners. The blue luminescent star shaped point is shimmering with light sparkles falling like mist as it moves. Its unclear what this may be used for, but it smells sweet like cotton candy and the handle is covered in slime. It seems to have belonged to someone of great importance. This color seems to be a rare variety. The blue star's temperature is fluctuating wildly, and the green velvet feels lucky when touched.

blends.name: Mysterious Sparkle Wand
blends.desc: The purple velvet staff is heavy, as if filled with rocks, and wrapped in silk banners. The luminescent star shaped point is shimmering with light sparkles falling like mist as it moves. It is unclear what this may be used for, but it smells sweet like cotton candy and the handle is covered in slime. It seems to have belonged to someone of great importance.

blends.name: Rusty Hook
blends.desc: This Rusty Hook still has an old wire attached to it. Maybe if bait is found, one could use this to catch a Small Fry. It looks as though it may only have one use left before it breaks...

blends.name: Wanderer
blends.desc:
The Wanderer roams the land, looking for something more. He travels from town to town getting by with what he can, and sometimes taking things he doesn't need. Supplied with the right gear, he could find a decent treasure, but a misfortune has met with him which left him dirt broke. His feet hurt from walking so far, so he could use a rest and maybe a drink. If he walks into the pub with the right attitude, he may not have to pay for his drink. The Wanderer has connections with people everywhere, but sometimes forgets when he has wronged one of them. His day-to-day life varies greatly as he travels where the wind takes him. The Wanderer is an experienced traveler, a sneaky thief, and a clever merchant.

This is a weekly airdrop target for Wanderer's Chest.

blends.name: Wanderer's Garment
blends.desc: The Wanderer's Garment is often worn by those who wander the Funlands aimlessly. This one smells like Mead and Fresh Piss, but perhaps it could be washed somewhere...

blends.name: Mechanical Bird
blends.desc: This whirring beakbot buzzes and clanks with every flap of its metallic wings. Ideal for wizards who need a companion for their tower, but who are allergic to birds and other companions. Crafted by Goblin Dwarf Elders, the clockwork mechanics that goes into creating one of these delightful arial automatons is extremely complicated, taking many years to fully learn and comprehend. A Mechanical Bird doesn't need training, food or any upkeep really, other than the occasional oiling to a squeaky wing.

blends.name: Child of Anubis
blends.desc: A Child of Anubis is a protector of the realm of death. Deciding the fate of mortals in an instant, and changing the fate of the world. Favor of Anubis is given to these lowly warriors, who place their own lives last in the list of what is important to them. This is indeed necessary to the Anubians, for life sustained means more hungry souls, who seek love and food till the land is sapped dry of all resources and all hope. A Child of Anubis will surely give their own life in order to prevent such madness, for a duel is bound inevitable by their own fate, and a soul is burned on each encounter with the Child of Anubis...

blends.name: Dungeon Raider (Shiny)
blends.desc: The Dungeon Raider used to be a wise, peaceful Seeker, traveling far and gathering precious resources on a meditative journey to distant lands, but over time, he learned much from his book of forgotten knowledge, and that expansive knowledge led him to desire the forgotten items of power which he learnt of... He faced the ultimate quest of finding the Warlock's Shade Robe, the Prismatic Power Wand, the Magic Hooked Javelin Rope, and the Magic Void Pack. Along this long and difficult mission, he acquired a very useful acquaintance who became inseparable from him the day they met... The Shadow Cave Demon Companion, who may be cursed, but he makes a damn good companion for someone like the Dungeon Raider, who has one main concern on his mind, which is the lust for new supplies for his infinite inventions and advanced mystical devices. After almost losing his mind and miraculously surviving his contact with the Shadow Realm, he was saddened at the thought that there were no items more powerful that he could find in this world, but he then realized that, with all of his knowledge, he could invent even more rare and magical items and share them with anyone he pleases! This notion inspired the Dungeon Raider, so he set out to find more ancient knowledge and rare crafting supplies by zooming through the Wasteland of Gukewat on his first major invention, the Hover Cycle, which propels him to distant dungeons and lands unknown. The items found there and the few people or beasts met along the way each teach their own lessons, and even with the powerful items of the Dungeon Raider, the mind is still needed to be sharp in dire situations, where a forgotten treasure or scroll could be incinerated along with the secrets within, for all eternity...

blends.name: Warlock's Shade Robe (Shiny)
blends.desc: The Warlock's Shade Robe is a legendary item that most will say is just a myth, but according to the legend, the otherworldly garb is able to phase parts of the body out of this realm of existence and back unharmed... It works by creating a telepathic link with its wearer to work in unison with the subconscious, sensing any danger before the conscious mind is even aware of what happened. In this way, the Warlock's Shade Robe will make its wearer reliant on its magic in risky situations, but there is always a risk when wearing the robe for too long. One may become bound to the item eternally, taking the item with them everywhere they go, even in death. Skilled master Dungeon Raiders know exactly how to use this legendary robe to its full potential and wield its power when phasing through secret trap doors and booby traps in the most dangerous parts of ancient dungeons. The items found in these labyrinths are considered worth any risk it takes to get them, that is, if these supposed items even exist... Dungeon Raiders will tell you that they do, and that death is the simple way out, but being bound to the Warlock's Shade Robe is a fate that some Dungeon Raiders are forced to take, living with a telepathic insanity, unable to be harmed until the day they completely lose it...

blends.name: Prismatic Power Wand
blends.desc: The Prismatic Power Wand is one of the legendary weapons of forbidden power. This item channels the energy of the Shadow Realm using a reverse engineering mechanism which draws energy up from the Shadow Realm instead of draining it. This energy can be used to nullify booby traps and rigged dungeon mechanisms by transporting other objects into the Shadow Realm, so this weapon can also be used as a great tool of protection for those who wander deep into the most dangerous dungeons and ancient tombs. It is made with a pure Rod of Blue Quartz, a Prismatic Power Crystal cursed with Demon Frenzy Liquiform, and a Magic Dice to help channel the powerful shadow magic. Conductive Ice Plasma is used to supercharge the wand and seal the materials together by shocking and freezing them in place. This helps the Prismatic Power Wand to have an additional capability where it can eject a beam of lightning at a target when the wielder grips the handle firmly and directs the magnetic waves from their brain into the rod to send the bolt of power out from the staff which may travel to any conductive material nearby, sometimes bouncing off clouds for increased distance. It is said that the first Prismatic Power Wand was found with a mysterious shadow creature, who crossed into this world by somehow using the item on itself. This specter beast protected the item until one day it was stolen and reverse engineered by a demented inventor, who figured out a way to recreate the powerful item using the guidance of a demon helper and a few rare materials he had lying around. It is said that only those who are close to death or have ties with the Shadow Realm are able to wield this wand without repercussions, but those who don't know what they are doing might as well consider themselves dead if they try to tame this untapped power...

blends.name: Woven Basket
blends.desc: This Woven Basket is made with roots, vine, or various types of leaves but most importantly it is crafted from patience. Perfect for carrying delicate items like fruit or bread, a basket of this size is always good to have around.

blends.name: Goblinite Easter Egg Basket
blends.desc:
This Goblinite Easter Egg Basket is filled with every color of goblinite egg. A whole set of these eggs is extremely rare to come by, so they are kept safe in a basket with colored fluff in the bottom. It is ancient goblin tradition to hide the eggs every year and have others search for them, sometimes for hours or even days at a time…

Some of these eggs look special, I wonder what is inside of them. Better keep an eye out for more eggs...

blends.name: Dung Dagger
blends.desc: The Dung Dagger is a basic beginner's weapon. Any novice fighter knows that a Dung Dagger is a cheap and easy way to enhance your fighting capabilities with very little to no experience. The hardening of dung is a ancient method of producing lethal materials from basic ingredients in order to mass produce cheap weaponry. Using this method, one is able to produce a low level army with dangerous, bacteria infected weaponry that is sharper than one would like to think...

blends.name: Elite Pyro Sage
blends.desc: The Elite Pyro Sage is a highly advanced communicator with the flame, and a well practiced wielder of Magic Fire. This sage is wise beyond the limits of time, having looked into the eternal flame and lived a thousand lifetimes there in a dreamscape. The Staff of Energy and the Helm of the Horned Sage are the favorite pyro relics of the Elite Pyro Sage, and they are used to both increase the power of the Magic Fire and to protect the sage from the blistering lick of the mystical flame. This defense is only needed when an opponent is powerful enough to manipulate or some how counter the Magic Fire, which obeys the mind of the flaming sage, being willed into whatever he can imagine. When a sturdy bone is enchanted with Promethean Favor, then it can be used to amplify the potential of any Elite Pyro Sage, which is a dangerous blaze of talent that no one wants to oppose.

blends.name: Loaf of Bread
blends.desc: This fresh Loaf of Bread is a scrumptious and versatile food in the Funlands. It provides energy and fiber, made from fresh Wild Grains. Salted with the finest Kullzian salts, this steaming hot loaf is not one to pass up.

blends.name: Wild Grain Dough
blends.desc: This Wild Grain Dough is salted and left out with a little sourdough starter and allowed to rise. Then it is kneaded and formed into bread, pasta, or anything that requires dough. It is an important ingredient especially to the chefs in the volcano kitchen of Kullzia, whom reside in the Kullzian volcano, cooking extravagant feasts for the Dragon Tamers to welcome them back from a voyage. They often require monumental amounts of protein and carbohydrates, so dough is valued highly and traded heavily to these cooks, who use large amounts of dough to create pizzas and pretzels bigger than a mammoth every week for their beloved elven goddess warriors.

blends.name: Bag of Flour
blends.desc: This Bag of Flour is made by finely grinding up Wild Grain. It is powdery and soft to the touch, making everything it touches white. The blend of milled grains can be mixed with Spring Water and Salt to make Wild Grain Dough, which can then be used to cook a variety of different breads, rice, noodles, and more! A Bag of Flour is a highly versatile ingredient, and should be in every cook's kitchen.

blends.name: Helm of the Horned Sage
blends.desc: The Helm of the Horned Sage is a powerful pyro relic, which can protect one's brain from even the strongest attacks. It is enchanted with the powerful spirit of the flame, blessed by Prometheus, who gifted the flame to mortals long ago. Crafting one of these rare crowns of bone takes much learning and practice at the Pyro Academy, where Pyro Shamans learn under the guidance of Elite Pyro Sages, in hopes that a pyromaniac prodigy is in the midst of the eager students. Combustion is always fun, but its better safe then sorry when dealing with a Magic Fire, which can burn a victim for up to 7 years after the initial contact.

blends.name: Staff of Energy
blends.desc: The Elite Pyro Sage's favorite weapon is the Staff of Energy. It is made from the sturdiest, fire retardant bone, and dipped in sacred Pyro Oil which can burn for days. The staff is coated with Tree Sap and scorched in order to increase the sturdiness of the bone, to clean the bone, and enhance the smell with the scent of sacred tree resins. Pyro Shamans surround the item as it is made, burning a large fire in a pit underneath and chanting into the flames, causing them to dance in a tamed manner, that channels the pyro energy into the staff. This ritual is known as an Energy Cleanse Ceremony and it summons the spiritual energy of combustion to create a perfect Staff of Energy. The ceremony always ends with a burning competition to see who can blow the highest flame. A wooden pole is placed in the mud with feathers up to the top. The flame is blown straight up by the Pyro Shamans, and whoever burns the highest feather wins. The winner is considered closest to the flame and is deemed owner of the sacred staff. This powerful gift connects the Pyro Shaman directly to the source of infinite life, allowing them to enter Sage Mode, putting them in a flow state trance that is out of this world. Being such a highly revered master of pyro arts, the Elite Pyro Sage who wields this staff is worshipped by many who follow the flame.

blends.name: Wanderer
blends.desc: The Wanderer roams the land, looking for something more. He travels from town to town getting by with what he can, and sometimes taking things he doesn't need. Supplied with the right gear, he could find a decent treasure, but a misfortune has met with him which left him dirt broke. His feet hurt from walking so far, so he could use a rest and maybe a drink. If he walks into the pub with the right attitude, he may not have to pay for his drink. The Wanderer has connections with people everywhere, but sometimes forgets when he has wronged one of them. His day-to-day life varies greatly as he travels where the wind takes him. The Wanderer is an experienced traveler, a sneaky thief, and a clever merchant.

blends.name: Rigged Dice
blends.desc: This Rigged Dice is either cheating, magic, or both. It was rigged by the Wanderer, and rewards are almost always doubled when this dice is in the Wanderer's possession. However, only one dice is permitted per Wanderer, because holding two is considered bad luck. The dice is rolled, and as if there was an invisible magnet, it flips over gracefully every time to reveal a lucky roll.

blends.name: Pharaoh
blends.desc: Oh Wanderers of the east, here is your newest God. Ruler of all the sands in this world and commander of a thousand legions, the Pharaoh has blood that runs deep with divine heritage. Born under the alignment of the planetary giants, in the darkest night, his birth illuminated the world upon his arrival. The Pharaoh is well known for his wealth, which surpasses the imagination of any mortal mind, but few know of his infinite wisdom in dealing with matters not only in this plane of existence, but in dealing with heavenly matters as well, as a walker between worlds and a communicator for gods and man. He is said to rule alongside a powerful deity that can not be trifled with, so he has millions who listen to his every command without hesitation. No one dares to question what the plans of the Pharaoh are, or else they are accused of questioning the very will of God and are flogged on site. In this way, the Pharaoh will always remain as a figure of power, being upheld by the people who suck up to him most. Even though this way of life seems unfair to most outsiders, the people in the sand love the Pharaoh as their ruler, especially when a new Pyramid is completed and the Pharaoh throws a luxurious grand feast for his people, sometimes even inviting the local desert wanderers to throw down. The Pharaoh often throws a feast at least once a week, after he has returned from his weekly adventures with his Humble Cave Goblin Companion into the caves of the desert where he looks for forgotten relics of divine power and communicates with the gods of old, who's spirits reside deep within the sacred, ancient tombs. The Pharaoh is a wise communicator, a worshipped ruler, and a divine explorer when he is not busy ruling in the land of infinite sands.

blends.name: Shamanic Nightmare
blends.desc:
Anger, hatred, resentment, regret. These things are far from a shaman's mind, but in times of weakness, they boil up like unchecked pasta, frothing about into the world to consume any silly ideas of 'love' or 'kindness' and replace them with the cruel truths of life. It is in this state when a Shamanic Nightmare manifests, along with an undeniable rage that simply can not be quelled, but instead must burn like the brightest fire, consuming all and everything in its wretched path. After having a dream so profound, anything that separates a shaman from their roots will be severed and burned. It is in this way, that a shaman may grow to reach their full potential.


Effect: Can be used to ascend a Shaman hero

blends.name: Explorer - Weekly Airdrop Target
blends.desc:
The Explorer used to be a Wanderer who roamed the land, looking for something more, but after many endless drunken nights of soiled pants and lost hopes at hijacking a Caravan, he finally found his huge discovery, which led his way as an Explorer. It wasn't easy obtaining the Sturdy Rope, Golden Robe of Protection, The Rigged Staff of Treasure and the Humble Cave Goblin Companion, but it was worth it for this adventurer to have a better chance at more important treasures beyond the heart's deepest desires. It doesn't matter how risky his new life may be, because this Explorer will gladly stare into the face of death now that he has a purpose beyond his wildest dreams. The Explorer is a skilled planner, a courageous adventurer, and a prized hunter of rare and forgotten treasures!


*This asset is a drop target for one weekly 'Explorer's Chest' pack.*

blends.name: Lightening Rod Tower
blends.desc: This Lightening Rod Tower is built from ancient goblin knowledge, and it is able to harness the very power of the gods. Pure energy from a thunder bolt is sent down the copper coils into the battery of this long forgotten technology to create a high amount of stored Voltage. Made from Bobjobian Steel and other mixed metals, this highly conductive structure is built to last even the toughest of storms. In the midst of a Torrential Storm, this metallic beacon will accumulate enough raw energy to power most goblin technologies that require electricity. Store up enough of this powerful Voltage in a safe place and something monumental could be obtained...

blends.name: Potion of Bewilderment
blends.desc: This Potion of Bewilderment is fully charged with electric energy and sparkles with some sort of magic. Upon inspection... one can not help but to be amazed and awestruck by this legendary, fizzling potion. It's effects could last for only 3 minutes of fun or could last for up to 3 weeks, especially if one takes it on an empty stomach. Be careful where you are when you drink this, for you could be seen as a braggart or a madman by those spectating the bewildering! Once consumed, a state of utter confusion will ensue, followed by epiphanies, belligerent yelling, or sometimes even song and dance. Magic used on the potion keeps a high voltage of dormant energy within the fluid, which is released once in the body, creating some quite shocking side effects. Some drink this potion on a quest to rediscover and reimagine oneself, but scientists will also use the potion to bring dormant organs or even dying patients back to life in extreme cases…

blends.name: Cyborg Brain
blends.desc: This Cyborg Brain was enhanced using a rare form of nanotechnology. It can be combined with cybernetic parts to create a powerful Brainborg. Some scientists would kill to get their hands on technology of this caliber. Be careful how you program the thought systems of this brain, as carelessness will not be tolerated once the cyborg is fully functional and able to formulate thoughts of its own free will.

blends.name: Brainborg
blends.desc:
The product of a terribly risky experiment, the Brainborg is mostly cybernetic parts, connected with a fully functional organic nervous system that requires very little sustenance to sustain itself. No one knows the exact details of the its origin, but the cyborg has a very hazy memory of turning on their creator and escaping. The IQ of it's organic brain is extremely high, and it is also enhanced further with a Nanochip that communicates with the brain directly. This technology is incredibly Impressive when it is under full control, but Brainborg's mood tends to spike wildly, making it impossible to predict when a rampage may occur. No one is safe around one of these rampages, as they tend to get out of hand quickly. With a genetically enhanced brain that works well with artificial intelligence, Brainborg knows what he can get away with, and will do what they please. When they are not creating absolute chaos for systems that have become too square for their liking, Brainborg is known to throw some of the biggest raves in all of the outer spirals of the galaxy. Their DJ name, simply "BB," tops the charts in galactic EDM circles as well as the most wanted charts in circles that despise galactic EDM. This is mostly due to the fact that BB's light shows typically consist of blowing up small, young planets and causing the occasional supernovae in the far reaches of the galaxy.

blends.desc:
